Running out of time, Cruise asked the stunt crew for coins to put in his shoes as counterweights. signals.description:
NorthEast United FC made it two wins from two in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27 with a 4-1 victory over Kerala Blasters FC in Guwahati!

Alaaeddine Ajaraie opened the scoring in the 15th minute. In first-half stoppage time he set up Antonio Moyano, so NorthEast went into the break 2-0 up. Momo Yansane pulled one back for the Blasters on the hour. Ajaraie got his second ten minutes later to put the hosts two goals clear again, and substitute Aman CK made it four eight minutes after coming on.
